scope: Corollary 10.2 (The prescribed bond-percolation crossing) of the manuscript “Square-lattice FK interfaces and nested loops for 1 <= q < 4” (preprints/Square-lattice-FK-interfaces-and-nested-loops-for-1-leq-q-lt-4-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d2ffa94ece599e88), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 63. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: At q = 1, with every edge, including every boundary edge, sampled independently with probability 1/2 and with no wiring, the probability of the event Cn defined in Subsection 1.3 tends to Z χ 0 [t(1 − t)]−2/3 dt Z 1 0 [t(1 − t)]−2/3 dt .
